name: Pozycjonusz SEO: Internal Links, Redirects & Site Audit
author: Pozycjonusz.pl

sections.description:
Pozycjonusz SEO draws a map of the internal links in your content and shows which pages nobody links to. For every orphan page it finds paragraphs on other pages that already mention the topic and lets you turn that phrase into a link with one click.

Everything is computed from your own database. The plugin does not send any data anywhere and does not load anything from outside your site.

Features

  • Dashboard — one score for the whole site, the most important things to fix first and quick access to every tool.
  • Internal link map — every page and post as a dot, every link in the content as a line. Drag, zoom, search, click for details.
  • Orphan pages — pages with no links from other pages, listed and highlighted in red.
  • Link suggestions — phrases on other pages that match an orphan’s title, with a one-click “Insert link”. Only that phrase changes; WordPress keeps a revision so you can undo it.
  • Content check — pages hidden from Google, missing meta descriptions, short texts, extra H1 headings and images without alt text, with filters and CSV export.
  • Images without alt text — fill in alt text for library images right in the list.
  • Broken internal links — links to addresses on your site that return an error or redirect. Only your own site is asked.
  • Redirects and 404 log — see which missing addresses visitors and Google hit, with a suggested target page, and redirect them (301, 302) or mark them removed (410) in one click. Redirects run only on 404 responses, so existing pages load exactly as before. The log keeps no IP addresses.
  • Site check — search engine visibility, HTTPS, permalinks, SEO and cache plugins, page builder and robots.txt at a glance.
  • Export — the map as PNG and all internal links as CSV.

Works with the block editor and the classic editor. Pages built with Elementor are shown on the map; links there are added in the builder.

Pozycjonusz panel (optional)

The plugin is fully usable on its own. If you also use the Pozycjonusz panel, you can add this site there to see Google Search Console, Analytics and Bing data per page. Connecting is done in the panel with a standard WordPress application password that you approve, and is never required.

When the panel is connected, this plugin lets it (with the permissions of the approved account only):

  • save SEO titles and meta descriptions to Yoast SEO, Rank Math or SEOPress,
  • read and edit text kept in custom fields (for example ACF), so word counts and links are correct and the text can be improved from the panel.

The plugin itself never sends data to the panel; the panel asks your site, like any other REST API client. You can disconnect it under Pozycjonusz → Panel connection.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins → Add New, or upload the pozycjonusz-toolkit folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Open Pozycjonusz → Link map. The plugin reads your content once (this takes a few seconds on most sites) and draws the map.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin send my data anywhere?

No. All tools work on your local database. There are no external requests, tracking or remote scripts.

What does the 404 log store?

Only the missing address, the number of visits, the time of the last visit and where the visitor came from (another site’s domain, or the page on your site). No IP addresses, user agents or cookies. The log keeps at most 2000 addresses and is removed with the plugin.

I already use Yoast SEO Premium, Rank Math or Redirection for redirects.

The plugin notices that and shows a warning on the Redirects screen. Keep your redirects in one tool so they do not override each other.

Which links are counted?

Links inside the content of published pages, posts and other public post types. Links in menus, widgets and footers are not part of the content and are not counted.

Can I undo an inserted link?

Yes. The change is saved like a normal edit, so the previous version is available under Revisions on the edited post.

Does the plugin show ads?

The dashboard (Pozycjonusz → Overview) shows a few offers of Pozycjonusz services. They are plain links: nothing is loaded from outside your site and nothing is tracked. No ads appear on other admin screens or on your website.

Who can use the tools?

Editors and administrators (users who can edit other people’s posts). Inserting a link also requires permission to edit that particular post.
sections.changelog:
0.9.2

  • New name: Pozycjonusz SEO. Nothing else changes, your settings and data stay as they are.

0.9.1

  • Request data is sanitized before it is stored in the 404 log.
  • Translations are delivered by WordPress.org language packs.

0.9.0

  • The Pozycjonusz panel can change the SEO title, description, noindex and canonical of posts, pages and products with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress and All in One SEO.

0.8.2

  • Tested with WordPress 7.1.
  • Code cleanup after the official Plugin Check (no change in behaviour).

0.8.1

  • Custom fields that hold only code (for example embedded Facebook posts) are no longer treated as page text.

0.8.0

  • Public custom post types (for example portfolio or service pages added by the theme) become available to the Pozycjonusz panel. Their editing screen in WordPress stays the same.

0.7.0

  • Pozycjonusz panel can edit text kept in custom fields (ACF and similar), with the same permissions as the post editor.

0.6.0

  • Pozycjonusz panel can also edit SEO titles and descriptions of categories, tags and WooCommerce product categories (Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress).

0.5.0

  • Pozycjonusz panel connection: the panel detects the plugin, can save SEO titles and descriptions to Yoast SEO, Rank Math or SEOPress, and reads text from custom fields (ACF).
  • Panel connection screen shows the connected account and lets an administrator disconnect it.

0.4.1

  • New dashboard with a site score, a “fix first” list and Pozycjonusz services.
  • Refreshed look of all screens.

0.3.0

  • New: Redirects and 404 — a log of missing addresses with suggested target pages, one-click 301 and 410, and a redirect list you can edit.
  • Broken internal links that return 404 get a “Redirect” button.
  • Warning when another plugin also manages redirects.

0.2.2

  • Content check refreshes right after the link map is rebuilt.

0.2.1

  • Reads text and links kept in custom fields (ACF and similar), for themes that leave the post content empty.

0.2.0

  • Content check: pages hidden from Google, missing meta descriptions (Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress), short texts, extra H1 headings, images without alt in the content, pages with no links in or out.
  • Images without alt text: fill in alt text for library images right in the list.
  • Broken internal links: links to addresses on your site that return an error or redirect.
  • Link map: show or hide content types.

0.1.1

  • Better link suggestions: anchors stop at punctuation, short single words are no longer suggested.
  • Faster overview screen and indexing (one query per post).
  • Works on WordPress 6.0 and newer.

0.1.0

  • First version: internal link map, orphan pages, link suggestions with one-click insert, site check, PNG and CSV export.
